effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until the end of their turn. Then, by suspending 1 of their Digimon or Tamers, unsuspend 1 of your Digimon.
[All Turns] When an effect plays or digivolves an opponent's Digimon, if you have a Tamer, this Digimon may digivolve into [Imperialdramon: Fighter Mode] in the hand without paying the cost.
